items.headline: Flood Watch issued May 12 at 2:51PM AKDT until May 13 at 10:00AM AKDT by NWS Anchorage AK
items.description:
* WHAT...Flooding caused by an ice jam continues to be possible.

* WHERE...Tuluksak, Akiak, Kwethluk, Bethel, Napaskiak, Oscarville,
and Napakiak.

* WHEN...Through Wednesday morning.

* IMPACTS...Creeks and streams may rise out of their banks.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- For Kwethluk: Ice jammed in the lower Kuskokuak channel at
and just upstream of the Y, or confluence with the Akiak
Channel of the Kuskokwim, has resulted in water rising in and
near Kwethluk. River Watch aerial reconnaissance
items.instruction:
Monitor the latest forecasts and be alert for possible Flood
Warnings. Those living in areas prone to flooding should be prepared
to take action should flooding develop.

Stay tuned to further developments by listening to your local radio,
television, or NOAA Weather Radio for further information.

items.headline: Hydrologic Outlook issued May 12 at 8:23AM AKDT by NWS Fairbanks AK
items.description:

miles below Tanana. A long stretch of heavy, bank to bank ice run

remaining within the banks. Downstream from the breakup front,

items.headline: Hydrologic Outlook issued May 11 at 11:07AM AKDT by NWS Fairbanks AK
items.description:
ESFAFG

...Locations Impacted...
Rampart and Tanana.

The Yukon River breakup front is currently downstream of Rampart.
The River Watch team will fly to Tanana today (Monday May 11th) to
report on surrounding ice conditions. Updates will be posted as
available.
